_comment: Hand-kept, reviewed in PRs. The patterns: the shells a page, a card, a section, a table or an overlay is built from. Rendered into components/index.md by npm run generate:agent; scripts/lib/patterns-index.mjs holds every name to its barrel and every doc path to a file.

patterns.name: PageLayout
patterns.use: Every full page: wraps it in the Frame with the Sidebar, the breadcrumb row and the Page with its 12-column content grid. `frame="focused"` for one task the person finishes or leaves.

patterns.name: Frame
patterns.use: The app frame under PageLayout: Sidebar, Page and Panel with no top bar. Reach for it directly only for a shell PageLayout does not give.

patterns.name: PatternSidebar
patterns.use: The Frame's Sidebar with its open tabs. PageLayout draws it from the config you pass.

patterns.name: Page
patterns.use: A tokenized box with a level (fill and shadow together), a pad and a radius. The Frame draws the page's own; use it for any other block that needs a level.

patterns.name: PatternSection
patterns.use: A span of the page grid under one heading, with its header, toolbar and tabs. No box of its own: the Page supplies the pad. `detail` for a list with a detail region.

patterns.name: PatternCard
patterns.use: A raised container for one object: a student, a session, a metric. Optional image, a header over the body, optional footer.

patterns.name: PatternTable
patterns.use: How a table sits on a page: inside a Section whose header carries the title and toolbar, with slots for pagination and the empty state.

patterns.name: PatternModal
patterns.use: The modal shell: centered in a Blanket, one task, title, body and footer, width a step of the screen grid.

patterns.name: PatternDrawer
patterns.use: A full-height panel at the screen edge, for a task that needs the page in view: a row's details, filters, a short edit.

patterns.name: Blanket
patterns.use: The full-screen layer under a modal or drawer. PatternModal and PatternDrawer bring their own; use it alone only for a new blocking layer.

patterns.name: Popup
patterns.use: The Popups pattern is four floating layers that never block the page, each a component: `DropdownMenu` lists actions, `Popup` holds a small aside anchored to a control, `Flag` reports what just happened, `Tooltip` names a control.

patterns.name: AiChat
patterns.use: AI chat as a popup, in the Frame's Panel or full screen, opened from one floating button.
